title: P6M in ‘smuggled’ cigarettes seized in Zamboanga del Sur
summary: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – Authorities intercepted around P6 million worth of suspected smuggled cigarettes and arrested a 38-year-old man during a joint intelligence-driven operation…

blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – Authorities intercepted around P6 million worth of suspected smuggled cigarettes and arrested a 38-year-old man during a joint intelligence-driven operation in Dumalinao, Zamboanga del Sur, early Wednesday morning. Capt. Derf Jay Maquinta, spokesperson for the Zamboanga del Sur Police Provincial Office (ZSPPO), said operatives apprehended the suspect, a resident of Buug, Zamboanga Sibugay, at around 1:25 a.m. in Sitio Baroy, Barangay Rebokon, Dumalinao. Seized during the operation were 101 master cases of illicit cigarettes with an estimated value of P5,787,300.
